pending.title: Claim: 'Division 296 imposes a 15% tax on all superannuation balances exceeding $3 million'
pending.description: This simplified claim appears frequently but the actual legislation is more nuanced. The ATO states Division 296 applies '15% on the proportion of earnings relating to your TSB that exceeds the LSBT' (Low Balance Threshold). The tax is NOT a flat 15% on the entire balance above $3m. Instead, it's 15% on the earnings attributable to the portion of your Total Superannuation Balance exceeding $3m. A $4m balance doesn't pay 15% x $1m = $150k; it pays 15% on the earnings generated by the amount above $3m, which is considerably less. Additionally, thresholds are indexed.
pending.suggestion: Add to fact-checks.json: claim is '15% tax on all super balances over $3m', verdict is partially_true because Division 296 taxes the earnings attributable to the excess balance, not the excess balance itself. A $4m balance doesn't incur $150k in Division 296 tax—it pays 15% on the earnings portion attributable to amounts exceeding $3m.
